title: Run detail drawer is translucent
detail: Text of the page behind the drawer (filters, run row, "Pause all publication") shows through the drawer in the two themes. Cause: the drawer uses .surface-1, which is a glass reading plane, not an overlay. Component: review-run-detail.component.ts (it is on main; not new in PR #1040).
state: Open. A test with data-glass-surface=overlay made the dark drawer opaque but broke the drawer layout in the light theme, so that edit was removed.

title: Drawer header is behind the navigation bar
detail: The title "PR #428 review" and the Close button are below the top navigation bar. The drawer starts at the top of the window with z-50. The review settings drawer has the same structure.
state: Open. Not fixed in this run.

title: Accept button stays gold after triage
detail: On an accepted or dismissed card the Accept button keeps the primary color and only Dismiss looks inactive. The state text below the buttons is correct.
state: Open. Not fixed in this run.
